fields.summary_ko.0: JPMorgan added Meta Platforms (NASDAQ:META) to its analyst focus list as a preferred internet stock, with shares rising 5% to record $641
fields.summary_ko.1: Q3 advertising revenue increased 26% year-over-year to $63.06 billion, with AI investments driving a 14% increase in cost-per-action and 10% rise in impressions
